graph_effect.label: Power-model exponent for injury crashes on urban roads (Elvik 2009); volume elasticity assumed 0.9

sources.note: speed findings in the graph; no volume or power-model findings

prediction_scored: not scored: a research link with no city test of its own. The volume elasticity of 0.9 is an assumption, not an estimate.
settle: A test of the speed exponent at low urban speeds would need crashes and speeds on the same street segments over time, for example NYC DOT segment speeds from the Traffic Speeds feed (i4gi-tjb9) joined to geocoded crashes on streets outside the zone.

research_needed.question: Does the power model hold at network speeds below 15 mph?
research_needed.data: Segment-level speeds and crashes in a dense city
research_needed.design: Panel of street segments with speed changes from signal timing or speed limits

notes: A research link, registered so that the bridge's chain names every link.
